environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate with task role restricted to ECR pull only. PostgreSQL RDS instance connection uses role 'reporting_ro' provisioned via Terraform aws_db_instance with parameter group enforcing `rds.force_ssl=1`. The database role was created with: `CREATE ROLE reporting_ro LOGIN PASSWORD '...' NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE; GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE appdb TO reporting_ro; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO reporting_ro; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO reporting_ro; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO reporting_ro;` — no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or TRUNCATE grants exist. The ECS task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem: true with only /tmp mounted as ephemeral storage (10GB, scoped to /tmp). Container runs as non-root UID 1000 with no added Linux capabilities. The Fargate platform version 1.4.0 applies default seccomp profile blocking mount/umount syscalls.

config.network: VPC security group allows egress to RDS port 5432 only within VPC
